boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Third Ward corridors, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Project Row Houses
cards.subtitle: Holman Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk to 2521 Holman Street and use the visitor map to orient yourself before viewing the Art Houses and Community Gallery.
cards.short_summary: A five-block Third Ward arts and community site.
cards.evidence_claim: Project Row Houses lists its location at 2521 Holman Street and identifies public Art Houses and a Community Gallery.
cards.source_title: Guided Tours & Groups — Project Row Houses
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Sunday; consult the institution’s visit page for current hours and tours.

cards.title: Historic Eldorado Ballroom
cards.subtitle: Elgin Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the current program calendar, then photograph the historic ballroom exterior at 2310 Elgin Street from the public corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named historic performance venue within the Project Row Houses campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Project Row Houses identifies the Historic Eldorado Ballroom at 2310 Elgin Street in Houston.
cards.access_notes: Programs and admission vary; confirm an event’s access details before visiting.

cards.title: Kindred Stories
cards.subtitle: Stuart Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow Stuart Street to 2304 Stuart Street and check the bookstore’s current schedule before planning time to browse.
cards.short_summary: A named bookstore stop beside the Elgin Street cultural corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Project Row Houses walking map identifies Kindred Stories at 2304 Stuart Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail access and hours should be confirmed directly before travel.

cards.entity_name: Gulf Coast Cosmos Comic Book Shop
cards.title: Gulf Coast Cosmos Comic Book Shop
cards.subtitle: Stuart Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Stuart Street address to locate this named comic-book shop, then confirm opening details with the business before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A comic-book shop listed on the Third Ward walking map.
cards.evidence_claim: The Project Row Houses walking map labels Gulf Coast Cosmos Comic Book Shop at 2306 Stuart Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail access and hours should be confirmed directly before travel.

cards.title: All Read Radio
cards.subtitle: Holman Street corridor
cards.notes: Add 2503 Holman Street to a Project Row Houses walk and look for the named All Read Radio stop along the corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named stop on the Project Row Houses walking route.
cards.evidence_claim: The Project Row Houses walking map identifies All Read Radio at 2503 Holman Street.
cards.access_notes: Confirm any public access arrangements with Project Row Houses before visiting.

cards.title: Zin Memorial Sculpture
cards.subtitle: Holman Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Project Row Houses walking map to locate the Zin Memorial Sculpture and include it as an outdoor visual stop.
cards.short_summary: A named memorial sculpture on the Project Row Houses route.
cards.evidence_claim: The Project Row Houses walking map identifies the Zin Memorial Sculpture by Catherine Martinez.
cards.access_notes: View from publicly accessible areas and follow any on-site guidance.

cards.title: Emancipation Park
cards.subtitle: Emancipation Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use 3018 Emancipation Avenue as the anchor for a daytime park stop, then continue south or north along the avenue.
cards.short_summary: A City of Houston park on the Emancipation Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Houston lists Emancipation Park at 3018 Emancipation Avenue.
cards.source_title: City of Houston — My Houston ZIP Code
cards.access_notes: Check City of Houston Parks information for facility availability before visiting.

cards.title: The Doshi House
cards.subtitle: Emancipation Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a morning or early-afternoon pause at 3419 Emancipation Avenue; the business lists daily 7:30 a.m.–3 p.m. hours.
cards.short_summary: A vegetarian café on the Emancipation Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Doshi House lists its address as 3419 Emancipation Avenue in Third Ward and states hours of 7:30 a.m.–3 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists service from 7:30 a.m. to 3 p.m., seven days a week.

cards.title: Crumbville, TX
cards.subtitle: Emancipation Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue along Emancipation Avenue to the named bakery marked on the Project Row Houses walking map; confirm current service details first.
cards.short_summary: A named bakery stop on the Third Ward walking route.
cards.evidence_claim: The Project Row Houses walking map identifies Crumbville, TX Bakery at 3409 Emancipation Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Retail access and hours should be confirmed directly before travel.

cards.title: Holocaust Museum Houston
cards.subtitle: Caroline Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the museum’s plan-your-visit page to schedule a focused museum visit at 5401 Caroline Street and review current visiting rules.
cards.short_summary: A museum destination on the Caroline Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Holocaust Museum Houston lists its Lester and Sue Smith Campus at 5401 Caroline Street and publishes visitor hours.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — Holocaust Museum Houston
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday noon–5 p.m.; verify admission details before visiting.
